## Agentic Systems Notation {#sec-notation-agentic}

Agentic machine learning systems operate at the software systems layer, introducing a dedicated notation for multi-turn execution trajectories, closed-loop runtime mediation, memory hierarchies, distributed Sagas, and trajectory economics. While single-model inference models individual forward passes and distributed infrastructure scales execution across clusters, this book defines the **verifiable trajectory** as the primary unit of systems engineering.

The central governing relationship of this book is the **Closed-Loop Agentic Trajectory**:

$$\tau = \big( (a_0, o_1, v_1), (a_1, o_2, v_2), \dots, (a_{N-1}, o_N, v_N) \big)$$

evaluated against the **Whole-Task Duration Law**:

$$T_{\text{task}} = T_{\text{model}} + T_{\text{tool}} + T_{\text{wait}} + T_{\text{runtime}}$$

the **Trajectory Goodput Law**:

$$\mathcal{G} = \frac{\sum_{i \in \mathcal{T}_{\text{success}}} T_i}{\sum_{j \in \mathcal{T}_{\text{all}}} T_j}$$

and bounded by the **Compounding Reliability Law**:

$$P_{\text{success}} \le \prod_{i=1}^N p_i \le p^N$$

### Agent trajectories and closed-loop control {#sec-notation-trajectories}

The closed-loop trajectory formalizes the execution trace of an agent policy interacting with external tools, isolated sandboxes, and deterministic verification oracles under runtime supervision.

| **Symbol**       | **Definition**                     | **Unit**             | **Notes**                                                                                                                         |
|:-----------------|:-----------------------------------|:---------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$\tau$**       | **Agentic Trajectory**             | Tuple                | Ordered sequence of candidate action proposals, environment observations, and verification signals over horizon $N$.              |
| **$a_t$**        | **Action Proposal**                | Token sequence / RPC | Candidate output emitted by policy $\pi_\theta$ at turn $t$ (internal deliberation or unprivileged tool call proposal).           |
| **$o_t$**        | **Environment Observation**        | String / Bytes       | Telemetry payload (stdout, stderr, exit code) returned across the sandbox boundary after tool execution at turn $t$.              |
| **$v_t$**        | **Verification Signal**            | Boolean / Score      | Empirical outcome from an external deterministic verifier (compiler, test runner, AST checker) gating state commitment.           |
| **$s_t$**        | **Ground-Truth Environment State** | State record         | Authoritative state of external systems (filesystem diff, database rows, Git commit tree) at turn $t$.                            |
| **$h_t$**        | **Working Context Buffer**         | Token sequence       | Logical working set assembled from task directives, structured state, and filtered observations for the forward pass at turn $t$. |
| **$\pi_\theta$** | **Neural Policy Core**             | Distribution         | Stochastic autoregressive model parameterized by weights $\theta$ evaluated under Zero Ambient Authority.                         |
| **$\text{ACB}$** | **Agent Control Block**            | Struct               | In-memory OS descriptor tracking trajectory identity, state machine phase, memory leases, and security capabilities.              |

### The H-S-A-C systems taxonomy {#sec-notation-hsac}

The H-S-A-C coordinate space classifies autonomous workloads across four orthogonal axes of systems complexity, state scope, and operational authority.

| **Symbol** | **Definition**          | **Unit**      | **Notes**                                                                                                                                                                   |
|:-----------|:------------------------|:--------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$H$**    | **Operational Horizon** | Turns         | Trajectory turn depth; sequential model-tool cycles required to satisfy the objective ($H=1$ atomic call to $H=1{,}000+$ fleet).                                            |
| **$S$**    | **State Complexity**    | Discrete rank | Scope of tracked mutable state: $S_0$ (stateless), $S_1$ (in-context buffer), $S_2$ (local sandboxed filesystem), $S_3$ (distributed external datastores).                  |
| **$A$**    | **Permitted Authority** | Discrete rank | Effector blast radius: $A_0$ (read-only query), $A_1$ (isolated sandbox mutation), $A_2$ (reversible production edit), $A_3$ (irreversible external side effect).           |
| **$C$**    | **Invariant Closure**   | Discrete rank | Verification rigor: $C_0$ (unverified open-loop text), $C_1$ (heuristic/LLM-as-judge score), $C_2$ (deterministic compilers/unit tests), $C_3$ (formal mathematical proof). |

### Token allocation, working memory, and context buffering {#sec-notation-tokens-context}

Context memory is managed as a multi-tier hierarchy: logical working-set tokens in host memory, physical key-value activation pages in GPU memory, and durable external storage.

| **Symbol**             | **Definition**                    | **Unit**     | **Notes**                                                                                                                                               |
|:-----------------------|:----------------------------------|:-------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$M$**                | **Input / Prompt Length**         | Tokens       | Staged context sequence length processed in parallel during compute-bound GEMM prefill.                                                                 |
| **$K$**                | **Generated / Completion Length** | Tokens       | Output sequence length generated sequentially during memory-bandwidth-bound GEMV decode ($O(K)$ critical path).                                         |
| **$S_{\max}$**         | **Context Buffer Capacity**       | Tokens       | Hard physical context window limit ($M + K \le S_{\max}$). Exceeding $S_{\max}$ triggers mid-trajectory allocation faults.                              |
| **$B$**                | **Serving Batch Size**            | Integer      | Number of concurrent forward passes. In single-agent autonomous loops, $B=1$, exposing the memory shuttle wall.                                         |
| **$K_{\text{delib}}$** | **Deliberation Budget**           | Tokens       | Test-time reasoning tokens allocated to explore hypotheses or intermediate lemmas prior to committing external actions.                                 |
| **$\mathcal{W}(t)$**   | **Active Working Set**            | Token subset | Minimal subset of historical context and environment observations staged into active memory at turn $t$ ($\mathcal{W}(t) \subset \mathcal{H}_{1:t-1}$). |
| **$K_{\max}$**         | **Token Budget Ceiling**          | Tokens       | Supervisory limit enforced by the Agent OS; execution halts when accumulated generation exceeds $K_{\max}$.                                             |
| **$T_{\max}$**         | **Wall-Clock Deadline**           | Seconds      | Hard end-to-end deadline enforced by runtime timers; triggers preemption or compensating rollback upon expiry.                                          |

### Silicon physics, memory hierarchies, and latency walls {#sec-notation-physics-walls}

Agentic workloads alternate between compute-bound prompt prefill, memory-bandwidth-bound token decode, and host-bound tool execution.

| **Symbol**                      | **Definition**                    | **Unit**      | **Notes**                                                                                                                                                                  |                    |                                                                                                      |
|:--------------------------------|:----------------------------------|:--------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$N_{\text{params}}$** / **$\  | \Theta\                           | $**           | **Model Parameter Count**                                                                                                                                                  | Integer / Billions | Total number of trainable weights in the neural core (avoids collision with trajectory horizon $N$). |
| **$P$**                         | **Numerical Precision**           | Bytes / param | Data storage size per weight or activation ($P=2$ for FP16/BF16, $P=1$ for FP8, $P=0.5$ for INT4).                                                                         |                    |                                                                                                      |
| **$\text{BW}_{\text{mem}}$**    | **Memory Bus Bandwidth**          | GB/s or TB/s  | High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) transfer speed across the processor memory bus.                                                                                                |                    |                                                                                                      |
| **$R_{\text{peak}}$**           | **Peak Compute Throughput**       | TFLOP/s       | Maximum hardware tensor core floating-point rate.                                                                                                                          |                    |                                                                                                      |
| **$I_{\text{sat}}$**            | **Roofline Saturation Intensity** | FLOP/byte     | Hardware balance point $I_{\text{sat}} = R_{\text{peak}} / \text{BW}_{\text{mem}}$. Prefill sits above $I_{\text{sat}}$; decode sits far below.                            |                    |                                                                                                      |
| **$I_{\text{decode}}$**         | **Decode Arithmetic Intensity**   | FLOP/byte     | Arithmetic intensity of unbatched generation: $I_{\text{decode}} \approx 2/P$ FLOP/byte, collapsing decode into memory-shuttle starvation.                                 |                    |                                                                                                      |
| **$\text{Mem}_{\text{token}}$** | **KV Footprint per Token**        | Bytes / token | Attention activation memory: $\text{Mem}_{\text{token}} = 2 L H_{\text{kv}} d_{\text{head}} P$ across layers $L$, heads $H_{\text{kv}}$, and dimension $d_{\text{head}}$.  |                    |                                                                                                      |
| **$M_{\text{KV}}$**             | **Total KV-Cache Footprint**      | Bytes (GB)    | Physical HBM allocation across active sequences managed via non-contiguous PagedAttention virtual block tables.                                                            |                    |                                                                                                      |
| **$T_{\text{prefill}}$**        | **Prefill Ingestion Latency**     | Seconds       | Compute-bound wall-clock time to ingest prompt tokens $M$: $T_{\text{prefill}} \approx \frac{2 M N_{\text{params}}}{R_{\text{peak}} \cdot \text{MFU}} + T_{\text{queue}}$. |                    |                                                                                                      |
| **$T_{\text{decode}}$**         | **Serial Generation Latency**     | Seconds       | Memory-bandwidth-bound wall-clock time for $K$ decode steps: $T_{\text{decode}} \approx K \cdot \frac{N_{\text{params}} P}{\text{BW}_{\text{mem}}}$.                       |                    |                                                                                                      |
| **$T_{\text{tool}}$**           | **Tool Execution Latency**        | Seconds       | Wall-clock duration consumed by external compilers, test runners, or sandboxes (incurs Tool-Wait memory stranding).                                                        |                    |                                                                                                      |
| **$T_{\text{runtime}}$**        | **Runtime Orchestration Latency** | Seconds       | Wall-clock time spent in context assembly, schema validation, seccomp filtering, and Write-Ahead Logging.                                                                  |                    |                                                                                                      |

### Supervisory runtime, fault tolerance, and distributed Sagas {#sec-notation-control-sagas}

Autonomous trajectories span external systems that lack distributed transactions; reliability is enforced through event sourcing and compensating Sagas.

| **Symbol**              | **Definition**                    | **Unit**     | **Notes**                                                                                                                                                      |
|:------------------------|:----------------------------------|:-------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$k_{\text{idem}}$**   | **Idempotency Key**               | String       | Deterministic handle $k_{\text{idem}} = \text{UUIDv7}(\text{agent\_id}, \text{turn\_idx}, \text{action\_hash})$ preventing duplicate mutations under timeouts. |
| **$\mathcal{T}$**       | **Forward Saga Sub-Transactions** | Ordered list | Sequence of discrete, forward sub-transactions: $\mathcal{T} = [T_1, T_2, \dots, T_n]$.                                                                        |
| **$\mathcal{C}$**       | **Compensating Transactions**     | Ordered list | Sequence of semantic inverse actions: $\mathcal{C} = [C_n, \dots, C_2, C_1]$ executed in reverse to amend state upon failure.                                  |
| **$\text{LSN}$**        | **Log Sequence Number**           | Integer      | Monotonically increasing sequence index assigned to every intent and observation record in the Write-Ahead Log.                                                |
| **$K_{\text{repair}}$** | **Forward Repair Bound**          | Integer      | Supervisory threshold on consecutive self-healing attempts ($K_{\text{repair}} \le 3$) before forcing rollback or escalation.                                  |

### Policy compilation, SFT, and verifiable rewards {#sec-notation-compiler}

Offline policy compilation fine-tunes model weights from verified trajectory traces using targeted loss masks and deterministic reward oracles.

| **Symbol**                             | **Definition**                  | **Unit**          | **Notes**                                                                                                                                          |
|:---------------------------------------|:--------------------------------|:------------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$m_t$**                              | **Action-Targeted Loss Mask**   | Binary $\{0, 1\}$ | Gradient indicator: $m_t = 1$ for model action and deliberation tokens; $m_t = 0$ for prompt and environment observation tokens.                   |
| **$\mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}}(\theta)$** | **Action-Masked SFT Loss**      | Cross-entropy     | Supervised loss computed strictly over intended policy proposals: $\mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}}(\theta) = -\sum_t m_t \log P_\theta(x_t \mid x_{<t})$. |
| **$R_{\text{oracle}}$**                | **Deterministic Reward Oracle** | Scalar / Boolean  | Automated objective reward computed by external software (compiler exit codes, unit tests, formal provers).                                        |
| **$\hat{A}_t$**                        | **Relative Advantage Estimate** | Scalar            | Policy optimization signal (e.g. GRPO normalized advantage) computed across candidate branches without a critic network.                           |

### Macro-efficiency, fleet economics, and tokenomics {#sec-notation-tokenomics}

Macro-efficiency measures whole-trajectory economics, capacity dimensioning, and accepted outcomes rather than isolated server throughput.

| **Symbol**             | **Definition**                    | **Unit**                   | **Notes**                                                                                                                                                 |
|:-----------------------|:----------------------------------|:---------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$\mathcal{G}$**      | **Trajectory Goodput**            | Fraction $[0, 1]$          | Proportion of allocated compute time or FLOPs dedicated to trajectories that reach mechanically verified completion.                                      |
| **$O_{\text{mem}}$**   | **Space-Time Memory Occupancy**   | $\text{GB} \cdot \text{s}$ | Resource integral $O_{\text{mem}} = \int_0^{T_{\text{task}}} \text{Mem}_{\text{KV}}(t) \, dt$, capturing memory stranding during high-latency tool waits. |
| **$C_{\text{task}}$**  | **Cost per Accepted Task**        | \$/task                    | Total financial expenditure (accelerator lease, host CPU, sandbox compute, tokens) per successfully verified deliverable.                                 |
| **$J_{\text{task}}$**  | **Energy per Accepted Task**      | Joules / task              | Total electrical energy consumed across prefill, decode, host execution, and verification per accepted task.                                              |
| **$\text{TAF}$**       | **Token Amplification Factor**    | Ratio ($\ge 1.0$)          | Multiplier between total tokens consumed across an agent fleet and initial user prompt tokens.                                                            |
| **$B_{\text{token}}$** | **Token Budget Allocation**       | Tokens                     | Maximum token budget allocated to a trajectory before preemption or human escalation.                                                                     |
| **$B_{\text{cost}}$**  | **Financial Expenditure Ceiling** | Dollars (\$)               | Hard monetary budget ceiling enforced by admission control to prevent runaway spending loops.                                                             |

### Cross-domain collision disambiguation {#sec-notation-agentic-collisions}

Agentic machine learning systems operate at the intersection of neural inference, operating systems, and distributed computing, creating unavoidable symbol collisions across these domains:

| **Symbol**      | **Neural Core Meaning**       | **Distributed Systems Meaning**          | **Agentic Systems Meaning**      | **Canonical Resolution in this Book**                                                                                                                                                              |         |                                          |
|:----------------|:------------------------------|:-----------------------------------------|:---------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------|
| **$\tau$**      | Drift threshold / Temperature | Checkpoint interval $\tau_{\text{ckpt}}$ | **Agentic Trajectory**           | Bare $\tau$ denotes the trajectory tuple. Temperature sampling uses $\tau_{\text{temp}}$. Checkpoints use $\tau_{\text{ckpt}}$.                                                                    |         |                                          |
| **$\text{BW}$** | Bandwidth (Iron Law)          | Interconnect / Fabric bandwidth          | **Accelerator Memory Bandwidth** | Preserves the universal $\text{BW}$ rule. Accelerator memory bus bandwidth is explicitly written as $\text{BW}_{\text{mem}}$ (never bare $B$).                                                     |         |                                          |
| **$B$**         | Batch size (mini-batch)       | Global batch size / Micro-batch          | **Single-Agent Batch Size**      | $B$ is strictly reserved for serving batch size. In single-agent loops, $B=1$ denotes the unbatched serialization wall.                                                                            |         |                                          |
| **$H$**         | Hidden dimension / Heads      | Host cluster nodes                       | **Operational Horizon Depth**    | $H$ denotes sequential turn depth in H-S-A-C. Attention heads use $H_{\text{heads}}$ or $H_{\text{kv}}$. Hidden dimension uses $d_{\text{model}}$.                                                 |         |                                          |
| **$N$**         | Dataset size (samples)        | Device / Accelerator count               | **Trajectory Turn Count**        | In trajectory probability bounds ($p^N$), $N$ denotes turns. Model parameter count uses $N_{\text{params}}$ or $\                                                                                  | \Theta\ | $. Cluster nodes use $N_{\text{nodes}}$. |
| **$M$**         | Minibatch size                | Message buffer volume                    | **Prompt / Prefill Tokens**      | $M$ denotes input sequence length. Memory footprint uses $M_{\text{KV}}$ or $\text{Mem}$. Million is denoted by the unit suffix $\text{M}$.                                                        |         |                                          |
| **$K$**         | Top-$k$ sampling parameter    | Pipeline stages                          | **Decode / Generated Tokens**    | $K$ denotes output token count ($M + K \le S_{\max}$). Budget ceiling uses $K_{\max}$. Thousand is denoted by the unit suffix $\text{k}$.                                                          |         |                                          |
| **$P$**         | Model parameters $P$          | Partition count                          | **Precision / Byte Width**       | $P$ denotes numerical precision in bytes per parameter ($P=2$ for FP16). Parameter count is written as $N_{\text{params}}$ or $\                                                                   | \Theta\ | $. Probability is $P_{\text{success}}$.  |
| **$T$**         | Wall-clock time (seconds)     | Tensor parallel dimension                | **Time / Sub-Transaction**       | Lowercase $t$ denotes step index; $T$ denotes wall-clock duration (e.g. $T_{\text{prefill}}, T_{\text{task}}$). In Sagas, calligraphic $\mathcal{T} = [T_1, \dots, T_n]$ denotes sub-transactions. |         |                                          |
| **$C$**         | Compute cost (FLOPs)          | Channel capacity / Communicator          | **Invariant Closure Rank**       | In H-S-A-C, $C$ denotes verification closure rank ($C_0\text{--}C_3$). Compute FLOPs use $C_{\text{compute}}$. Financial task cost uses $C_{\text{task}}$.                                         |         |                                          |
| **$a$**         | Activation tensor             | Acceleration factor                      | **Action Proposal**              | $a_t$ denotes the candidate action emitted at step $t$. Learning rate uses $\eta$ or $\alpha$. Activations use $\mathbf{A}$ or $\mathbf{h}$.                                                       |         |                                          |
| **$s$**         | Sequence length               | Seconds (time unit)                      | **Environment State**            | $s_t$ denotes external environment state at turn $t$. Sequence length uses $M$ (prefill) and $K$ (decode). Seconds uses the upright unit $\text{s}$.                                               |         |                                          |

### Additional systems units {#sec-notation-agentic-units}

* **Trajectory Goodput ($\mathcal{G}$)**: Reported as a percentage or fraction in $[0, 1]$. In contrast to raw serving throughput ($\text{tokens/s}$), goodput accounts only for compute and tokens expended on trajectories that pass external deterministic verification gates.
* **Space-Time Memory Occupancy ($O_{\text{mem}}$)**: Denominated in Gigabyte-seconds ($\text{GB} \cdot \text{s}$) or Megabyte-hours ($\text{MB} \cdot \text{h}$). Measures physical accelerator memory residency integrated across prefill, decode, and tool-wait intervals.
* **Unit Economics**: Financial expenditure is normalized as US dollars per resolved task ($\$/\text{task}$); energy efficiency is measured in Joules per resolved task ($J/\text{task}$) or kilowatt-hours per resolved task ($\text{kWh}/\text{task}$).
* **Token Volume and Velocity**: Context capacities and cumulative consumption use $\text{kTok}$ ($10^3$ tokens) and $\text{MTok}$ ($10^6$ tokens); serving throughput uses $\text{tokens/s}$.
